category: product analytics with autocapture (hosted, by Contentsquare)

free_tier.stated: Free plan: up to 10k monthly sessions with core analytics charts, unlimited enrichment sources, guides integrations, 6 months of data history and SSO; no CSV exports; past the monthly limit data is neither dropped nor throttled but stays hidden until the account upgrades
free_tier.notes: The unit is the session, a period of activity of one user that ends after 30 minutes of pageview inactivity on the web and 5 minutes on mobile; the vocabulary has no sessions term, so mixed is the nearest. The sign-up button reads Start Free Trial, and whether the Free plan has an end date is unverified: not stated on the pricing page.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-event size is stated on the pages read

retention.stated: 6 months of data history on Free, against 12 months on Growth; 3 years is an add-on for Pro and Premier

egress.terms: CSV exports start on the Growth plan and are not part of Free; the server-side APIs send data in and delete users, and no read API is named for Free

interface_detail: Server-side APIs send server-side data, including user and account properties, into Heap and delete users with an auth token; an EU datacenter needs the calls sent to c.eu.heap-api.com. Events from sites and apps come from the web snippet and SDKs. Which APIs are open to the Free plan is unverified: the pricing page's APIs row did not keep its marks.
tooling: the web snippet and mobile SDKs with autocapture, the server-side APIs and the web app
chaining: Autocaptured product analytics for the front end of a free-hosted app, up to 10k sessions a month, with 6 months of history and no event tagging.

limits.value: up to 10k monthly sessions on Free
6 months of data history on Free

limits_note: Free has no CSV exports, no unlimited users and reports and no chart customization, which start on Growth.
binding_note: The 10k monthly sessions are the ceiling, and past it the data is hidden until the account upgrades.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up form asks for a first name, a last name, a work email address, a password, a company name, a company size and a storage region in the US or the EU, with an optional phone number; no card field appears on it. The button reads Start Free Trial.

reliability_note: past the monthly session limit data is not dropped or throttled, and the owner receives an email asking to upgrade before the data can be viewed again
confidence_note: Plan limits are quoted from the first-party pricing page, read through a pinned page reader, and the sign-up fields from the sign-up page. No account was opened, so later steps are unverified: behind a sign-up.
